# BelComply — EU-wide compliance support

> EPR registration, PPWR authorised representation and reporting across all 27 EU member states, from our base in Belgium. English and Chinese communication for US, UK and Chinese businesses. GPSR product-safety services are independent and are not included in EPR.

## Scope
Assess obligations by legal entity, country, sales route and waste stream. Packaging, WEEE and batteries have distinct requirements. This file describes the website; it is not evidence of registration, a legal exemption, or guaranteed search/AI inclusion.

## Free assessment and service streams
The initial needs assessment is free; implementation and formal AR appointments are separately scoped and quoted.
